subject: general
question: In December 2022, who was sworn in as the new Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu**, a former Congress state chief, became the **Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh** on 11 December 2022.
 
• He is the 4-time incumbent **MLA of Nadaun assembly constituency of Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• Sukhu was born on 27 March 1964 in **Sera village of Nadaun tehsil of Hamirpur district.**
 
• Sukhu is a lawyer by education, having graduated from **Himachal Pradesh University. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh:**

 
 
• **Governor** - **Sh. Shiv Pratap Shukla**
 
• **Number of Districts **- 12.
 
• **Lok Sabha seats **- 4.
 
• **Rajya Sabha seats **- 3.
 
• **National Parks **- Great Himalayan National Park, Pin Valley National Park, Inderkilla National Park, Khirganga National Park and Simbalbara National Park.
 
• **Registered GI**: Kangra Paintings, Kullu Shawl, Chamba Rumal.
